reviews.text: Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Very friendly staff. Super helpful.

Very kind, clean, reasonable pricing, and the staff in the adjoining Petco were so helpful! I’m going to give a 3 star though because I didn’t get answers about my pet’s issues, and had to go see a different vet two days later where my pet had to get IV fluids because the issue was unresolved for so long (constipation/dehydration). I would love to try again and see if it was just the vet I saw, being more of a surface level dr versus an investigative one. But… isn’t that what vets/drs are supposed to do?
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

So many of these bad reviews are not a recent experience in reality! This place was fantastic.
I have the Vital Care program, so the exam was free, and they were so kind and helpful! From the lady at the front desk to the nurse and doctor, and even the Petco folks in the store! They helped me pick out the items I needed for my pup, carried them to the front for me, and then even out to my car so I didn’t juggle the box and my dog. I was super impressed.

The prices are really fair; pet care is expensive, and this place was half what I usually have to pay my vet in Colorado! I will be back.

After bringing my dog in for an emergency situation, she was misdiagnosed. Additionally, I called multiple times following the injection she received for some information. I even physically went into the location trying to speak someone. No one returned my calls and I could not receive any informaiton no matter how hard I tried. Did not feel they cared about my pet and her care at all. I would never return here.

I am extremely disappointed in this Vetco after having visited twice within a month and getting no results. Every time I call with questions I am dismissed and spoken to with attitude and the answer I’m always given is that they are too busy. When I originally called back to get flea treatment the vet had prescribed the wrong medication and I asked if they could fix it for when I came in to pick it up. Upon arrival it was not fixed and I was told they were too busy the day I called. The vet called me with results and told me to feel free to call back with any questions I had. I called back & left a voicemail, after a week I did not hear back so I called again to be told they are too busy and she doesn’t know what to tell me other than to bring my cat in for a third time and doesn’t understand what questions I would have since the results came back fine.  I told her I wanted to speak to the vet to figure out what the next steps are for testing/medication because I don’t want to continue coming in and spending hundreds of dollars with no results to help the on going issue especially since I went back the second time to have this resolved. I was told I would get a call back and to no surprise three days later,I did not receive a call back. The only thing Vetco cares about is making more money hence trying to make me come in multiple times instead of doing all the testing after I had already come in twice. Other than for normal routine vaccines I wouldn’t bother coming here. I will be taking my business to a vet that actually cares.

Vet visits are always like going to the dentist for me. I’m always anxious and leave with a lot less money than I had when I got there. lol
Aside from that, I couldn’t be happier with the service and professionalism of the Vetco team @ the Sports Arena location. Everyone was attentive, concerned and able to explain everything to me in a way that I could understand. They were understanding when I wasn’t able to proceed with everything suggested for my pet and modified the care plan to work with my budget and still care for my pet.
We're sorry to hear that your recent experience resulted in a less-than-positive rating. Your feedback is important to us.
We took our senior dog here and the whole staff was great. Maria was very helpful and nice. Dr. Smith was very knowledgeable and helpful as well. Overall an amazing experience.
Took my newly adopted dog here for his first visit and we had a positive experience. The staff were very friendly and helpful.

STOP DONT TAKE YOU PET HERE. SAVE MONEY AND GO TO MEXICO !
I usually don't go out of my way to write a review but I'm very upset. I took my dog in because she wasn't being herself. They weighed her and then took us into a room. The doctor checked her and asked me what was wrong.  I told him she was having a hard time moving around, she stopped eating and she was breathing very fast. He said he probably needed to do some x-rays on why she wasn't moving around much and since i said her breathing wasn't normal he would see about that. Nurse came back with a quote of $1100. I was shocked 😲.  Called my friend and she said to go to Mexico ( Tijuana). I told the nurse it was to much and I was still charged $90 for the visit. Basically I was charged for my dog to get weighed and for a ridiculous quote  .
The vet in Mexico took my dog right away. He gave her a bath cuz she was having a heat stroke because she had a feaver. They put her on ice packs, put an IV on her, blood work and  4 shots.  The reason that she wasn't moving much was because she was constipated. They also gave me medicine for her to take home, ice packs and a can of dog food. All of this for $100. Save your money and your pets life.
I have Vital Care for my dogs so it's great to be able to make a same day wellness check up and not have to pay the exam fee. The service is great and my dogs love the technicians and vets here.
Judy was super helpful!!

Dr. McFly, Alexandra, and all the front desk stuff were very professional, and friendly.
Appointments are very easy to set up or change if someone needs. Truly recommend Vetco total care to all animal owners.
Alexandra & Dr. Radiology were helpful in giving us suggestions for our dog care. They were knowledgeable and attentive in helping us.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

Alexandra took such good care of my 10 month old pup with an ear infection. She tested both ears and was able to come back in a few minutes to tell me that she had a yeast infection in one ear.
She thoroughly cleaned the ear and put a medicine in that would work for three weeks. She explained everything very well. She was very patient with my dog who had never had much medical care before.
Thank you Alexandra!
Fantastic vets, highly recommend!

They advertised dental care, so I brought my cat in for what I thought was a pre-dental checkup. The vet spent 5 minutes with her checking her mouth and said I'd have to go to another location to get X-rays and dental care. And I was charged $40 for the appointment! Why did they charge me for an appointment when they can't follow up with the advertised treatment?? So then I would have to go to another location and pay for a pre-dental checkup? Not a chance.

Dr. McFly and Alexandra were great! They helped us with our cats skin issue. They offered a couple different solutions. We felt like they were honest and weren't trying to sell us on everything and anything, just what was needed. We are happy to have found our new vet! For sure recommended!
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

I really love this Vetco Clinic. Dr. Sharon's bedside manner was amazing and calming- especially since nobody comes into the Animal Hospital for fun! She was patient, answered all of my questions (I always have a ton of questions), extremely kind, and very informative. She made reasonable suggestions and gave great advice and followed up with me the very next day via text. She is extremely responsive and trustworthy, and we will definitely be bringing our dogs back here anytime they need to be seen! Thanks so much for your care, Dr. Sharon!
Great staff and expert vets.  Dr. Ivers was great!
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

I recommend this place - reasonable prices and good service. On February 14th, we gave our cat her annual vaccinations, and all the staff were very friendly and attentive. Unfortunately, I don't remember the doctor's name, but he gave our cat her vaccinations very quickly and professionally, and she didn't even have time to get scared. We really liked everything!
Scheduling appointments is quick and easy. Office is clean and the staff is very friendly and knowledgeable (and willing to hunt you down if you take a walk in the store proper)
Quick and easy. Free exams if you have vetco card which I would highly recommend. Staff are caring.

Alexandra and dr was amazing. We had an amazing experience!!! professional and amazing !!
Alexandra was a lot of help. She took me through the store and help me find a more healthier choice dog food for my pet and also gave me some advice. Thank you for all your help.!!! I will be back here again. I have a pug and we got his anal glands expressed, and it was very affordable.

Maria and Dr. Ivers were amazing to work with! They were so kind, they listened and explained everything clearly and throughly. It didn’t feel like any products or services were being pushed or forced on us… 10/10 highly recommend!

Dr. Sharon and VETCO staff has been helping us for around 3 months now with our puppies. They worked very diligently when the puppies had worms, and had great communication. I will definitely keep coming back and will always recommend friends to do so! Staff are very friendly, and caring. They help you in an extremely timely manner. 10/10!
Very kind professional staff. Didn't wait long and had multiple staff members attending to my situation.

I have been to this vetco multiple times and I will not be returning. I came in recently for a specific issue, they ran tests and said there was nothing and I needed to see a dermatologist and essentially sent me on my way. I decided to go to another vet for a second opinion, they ran tests and immediately came back with results and solutions for me and were much more caring and thorough. I wasted so much money at this vetco with no solutions. Not to mention, I frequently felt ignored and dismissed at this location. I wish I could get my money back - I am so glad I went somewhere else and got a second opinion.
Very professional, helpful and good treatment for Sonny, as always!
Very professional and thorough exam.   Antibiotics cleared up eye infection.
Very good service and knowledgeable doctors.  My dog is well taken care of at Vetco sports arena and we are very happy.
Best vet clinic experience. Thank you Dr. Ivers and the rest of the crew! Everyone was so great with my nervous cat. The whole thing was a breeze.

Alexandra and Dr Ivers are the best! They remembered me and knew just how to calm my dogs nerves. I love coming to Vetco, they always take such good care of my pup. Also thrive care is the best and makes it so much more affordable!
Bad experience
Very professional, only place where I can trust ❣️
Dr. Ivers is back and happy to have her care for Bear. Doesn’t upsell and does just what is needed. Appreciate her time.
Staff was super friendly and helpful in making sure my dog felt safe and cared for, and explaining services and prices in detail. I truly appreciate the staff!

Dr. Sharon was great at treating Luna who had a foxtail in her paw.  She initially flushed the abscess, did not find anything.  She said with the bandage she placed on her, and if the cause of the wound was a foxtail, it would be out in three days. Sure thing, at her follow up appt there was the foxtail.  Now we are in the wound recovery phase and hope to do well with her care instructions.  Thank you Dr. Sharon and staff.
Very supportive, informative and sympathetic.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
The staff is nice but the vet services are ridiculously expensive there

Dr. Sharon Smith and tech Maria were amazing to my puppy when I took him in. They were loving and very understanding. I felt very comfortable with them taking care of my puppy and they explained everything to me in a way that was easy to understand and not overwhelming!
Great service from technician Felix, great customer service, a great person, very kind, he treated Magnus and us in the best way, speaking of Dr. Metly, very attentive to every detail.

Thank you, Dr. Sharon Smith and Felix, for the exceptional care you gave our chihuahua/pomeranian, Buster. We truly appreciate your compassion and professionalism. You both were helpful, friendly, and took the time to explain everything clearly before and after Buster's checkup and blood work. Thank you for making us feel so comfortable.
Dr. Smith and Alexandra were super helpful and throughly answered all of our questions!
It was perfect, attentive and dedicated.Alexandra and Dr Mcfly thank you so much

They traumatized my dog. He had a growth and due to their poor handling of him, he ripped it off. They could not stop the bleeding and sent us to an urgent care because they were ill equipped. Our dog won't even get in the car now because he thinks it means he'll have to go back there.
We're thrilled to see that you gave us a high rating! Your support means a lot to us, and we're glad we could provide you with a positive experience.

No compassion! My dog was clearly nervous. The girl checking us in didn't seem to know how to get a nervous dog on the scale and she had no treats to woo my dog. I finally i got her on the scale then learned i could not go in with her to reassure her. That is ridiculous and a deal breaker for us. We left without vaccinations. Waste of time.

They don’t have medicine to fill your prescription here. Also, Total Care is separate from regular VetCo, and regular VetCo will not accept the script. Terrible experience having a company with the same name but scripts are not honored

One star because the front desk was rude and unreasonable. I called Vetco at the Sports Arena location to let them know I was running 5 minutes late, and the guy told me I’d be “far too late” for my appointment. I’ve literally never heard of a vet, or any place, not allowing at least a 5-minute grace period especially when calling ahead and letting them know there’s a delay. When I clarified that they really didn’t have a 5 min grace period l he asked to put me on hold to “look into it.” I was five minutes out. Look into what? Felt like he wanted to stall so by the time he found an answer, it’d be too late/more than 5 minutes. I ended up hanging up. I tried to be respectful and give them a heads-up, and I got attitude instead. Won’t be rescheduling here.
Everyone from my first contact made me and my dog feel welcome. Really nice customer service. Thank you

If your dog shows any signs of nervousness at the vet, I’d recommend looking elsewhere. Dr. Smith made a snap judgment about my dog without taking the time to understand or work with us. She spent most of the appointment speaking to him in a baby voice, but then shoved a used ear swab in his face to show him how bad his ear infection was—completely ignoring how overwhelmed he already was.

Well its corporate and there vets are never there for more then a day or so.  I literally i needed to make a decision on the spot for an 800 checkup or i would have to pay again for a revisit.  nickle and dime.  ohh and since when is it ethical that the vet gets % of commission for the tests she does on your pet!! They say nothing is free.  - =)

Was my first time and I won't go back based off the man at the reception. I loved my experience to a certain point. The vet tech was very nice and informative. Doctor was chill and informative. It did turn into an upsell situation and I had to get the paperwork revised for what I actually came in there for. I'm really giving this place a 1 star for my experience with the guy at front desk. Was my 1st time and based off with my ending interaction with him. He was not kind and once a new person came into the lobby he made comments like they are regulars and treated me like I need to just get out of his way.
At end of it I was so put off by his customer service. I asked for assistance to exit since they put up a barrier and I had my dog who was already a nervous from the visit. The guy didn't move or say anything to help. I ended up dropping the barrier trying to move it to exit and struggled to pick it up with one hand. He clearly saw me struggling and ignored me to help the regular customer. I just felt pushed out and treated poorly at end of my experience.
I wouldn't recommend anyone going in for first time because they don't treat people the same respect and warmth if it's a regular or a new person.

I love this vet so much! Everyone here has always been so kind and helpful but I want to shout out Kiana, Felix, Sean, and the manager Daniel. They very attentive and do a wonderful job addressing concerns and easing worries! Thank you!!
The hospital is clean and the staff is very helpful and patient. Doctors are very knowledgeable and caring. Thank you for taking care of my pets.

I can't recommend Vetco highly enough! They have consistently provided exceptional care for my chug, Greta. From the moment we walk in, the staff is welcoming and attentive, making both me and Greta feel right at home. The veterinarians are knowledgeable and take the time to answer all my questions, ensuring that I understand every aspect of Greta's health. Their genuine love for animals truly shines through in the way they handle each pet with kindness and compassion. I always leave feeling confident that Greta is in the best hands. Thank you, Vetco, for your wonderful service!
Dr. Ivers and her team were so amazing and caring towards my pup. They went above and beyond to help her and help me understand how to care for her ear infection
Ok, so like, this pet clinic is totally awesome or something like that!!

My dog ​​had an appointment with Dr. Smith on January 24th and I have to thank her. She was very attentive and helpful. I would also like to thank Dr. Smith's assistant (I don't know his name) who was patient and helpful from the beginning. P.S.: my dog ​​is doing much better! Thank you very much.

Staff is very friendly and accommodating and facilities are clean. I have several pets who have been seen by Dr. McFly, Dr. Smith, and Dr. Ivers and every time they have been attentive, caring, and patient with us and our pets. The staff are always available and fast to respond to texts during the business hours about any concerns as well. Highly recommend this Vetco Total Care to everyone who wants the best care and support by people who treat your pets like their own!!

Vetco has been incredible in caring for my boy! Recently, my Doberman has faced some health issues, and both Dr. Ivers and Dr. Smith have been amazing in providing the care he needed, while also offering me peace of mind. Dr. Ivers has been especially thorough in explaining the diagnosis, helping me understand it, and making sure I feel confident in caring for him. She goes above and beyond by regularly checking in on him and following up to ensure the treatment is working. I truly appreciate the level of care and attention we've received at Vetco, and I’ve had a wonderful experience with both Dr. Ivers and Dr. Smith.

My family and I are from Brazil, we had a veterinary appointment in May 2024 and we loved the store and the veterinarians. However, the documents we needed were not drawn up correctly. Now I need to get in touch with the veterinarians, but I can only get their phone number. I would like to know if there is any contact via email? My English is not that good for talking on the phone. We need to contact Dr Hannah Ivers please
Very quick and helpful. My dog has a lot of anxiety and the staff are great in helping him.
HORRIBLE PLACE ILL NEVER TAKE MY DOG THERE AGAIN.

Truly wish I could give this place 0 stars. I booked an appointment for my dogs annual vaccines. When I arrived they said because this place was an animal hospital they had to charge me for a full exam before he could get his shots, so I went online and used my free exam voucher since I had taken time out of work. Then, the Vet came in she was kind and we talked about my dogs overall health when she left, her assistant came back in with an iPad trying to charge me for several service I said I did not want. She never went over the charges with me and they ended up charging me for a heartworm test specifically after I said I didn’t want it. When I told her that she said oh well you signed the iPad so you have to pay and I repeated that I had specifically said I didn’t want that. She left the room and came back saying I had to pay it because they had already uploaded it to their system and once again, I had signed the iPad so I had to pay for the test. On the way out she told me my dog tested positive for something if I even cared and then left without giving me any additional information. A week later, his records still haven’t been updated and I still have no additional information about what he tested positive for. This is the worst experience I’ve ever had with not only a vet, but overall. Vets assistant was extremely rude and unhelpful. I was considering swapping over to Vetco, but I will never come back to one of their animal hospitals EVER again and I highly recommend the same for you and your pet. Skip the hassle and the disrespect, the services aren’t worth it.

The reception area was very well organized, and the tech came out greeted us wait our dogs and put us in a room. Dr. Ivers came in examined one of my pups chewy Alistair, and then she examined my other pup. I also wanted to say Dr. Ivers was amazing and the staff was amazing and courteous will go back

I am completely frustrated and unhappy with this place! The attendant Daniel Hernandez said he had scheduled my dog appointment to get the second shot of the vaccine and I arranged my schedule to take my dog. When I arrived there today he had not scheduled any appointment. The attendant Alexia who was there today was not helpful. Furthermore, they said today that we should wait another week to get the second shot of the vaccine. But that wasn't said in the first appointment we went to. In other words, we wasted time going there because even if it was scheduled, the vaccine would not be recommended.

I DO NOT RECOMMEND this place to anyone! I felt totally disrespected!

The girl at the check in was friendly and helpful. We did have to wait around quite a bit in the exam room before someone came in. But they did let us know they had multiple people call out sick that morning.  So they were short staffed. …

Beware...
Took my 6 month Rottie Pup to Petco Vital Care Sports Arena.  Veterinarian Caitlin Sullivan misdiagnosed him with an undescended testicle (Cryptorchidism). …
POOKIE relieved of tormented paw licking and scratching....
I love the mission gorge and Point Loma locations. Dr. Ivers is so kind and so caring. Very grateful for them saving my babies life ❤️

Their service is awful. They barely look at your animal for the wellness check. They don’t care about to the well being of your animals. They wrote us a prescription for antibiotics but then denied the request because at first they claim …
